stories.headline: Andy Burnham rejects 'tax and spend socialist' comments
stories.description: The prime minister insists he is prepared to take "difficult decisions" at next month's Budget.

stories.headline: Norway’s sovereign wealth fund profits from Israeli holdings amid genocide
stories.description: As Gaza is being destroyed, the so-called oil fund enjoys robust returns from companies linked to Israel’s military.

stories.headline: Gold mine collapse kills at least 70 people in Sudan’s West Kordofan
stories.description: Dozens of artisanal miners have been killed after a series of adjoining mining shafts collapsed.

stories.headline: China willing to ‘safeguard Iran’s legitimate rights’, official says
stories.description: China says the US-Israel war on Iran highlights flaws in the Middle East’s ‘existing security architecture’.

stories.headline: What is BRICS Pay, and can it rival the West’s SWIFT payments system?
stories.description: BRICS Pay is a decentralised digital system for making international payments in currencies other than the dollar.
